backend/main.mo: Actor exposes getEgoPrincipal returning the caller principal.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing files, components, and test IDs for publishing the build to a custom domain.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries for many frontend files describing quiz logic, components, styles, and data sources.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining OKLCH color tokens for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: Declares the custom domain sciquiztn-knowledgebyte for Internet Computer deployment.
frontend/README.md: Documentation explaining quiz levels, question file formats, required fields, and feature overview.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app handling authentication, quiz level selection, question loading, state transitions, and navigation across quiz screens.
frontend/src/components/BackgroundMusicC: Popover-based UI component for toggling mute and adjusting background music volume.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmModal.tsx: Reusable confirmation modal built on alert-dialog with configurable title, description, and actions.
Displays a footnote-style callout with optional title and separator.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: App layout with header, identity controls, music controls, quiz level tabs, and styled container structure.
frontend/src/components/ProgressIndicato: Progress display showing current question percentage using a progress bar.
frontend/src/components/QuizLevelTabs.ts: Renders tab-style buttons for selecting a class level and triggers onChange when clicked.
frontend/src/components/ReadingPanel.tsx: Displays main reading content with an optional footnote section in a styled layout.
frontend/src/data/questions_class10.js: Provides Class 10 science quiz questions with multiple-choice options and correct answer indices.
frontend/src/data/questions_class7.js: Stores Class 7 science quiz questions organized by units with options and correct answer indices.
frontend/src/data/questions_class8.js: Includes Class 8 science quiz questions covering measurement and other units with correct answers.
frontend/src/data/questions_class9.js: Lists Class 9 science quiz questions with answers and unit tags for measurement and motion topics.
frontend/src/data/questions.js: Contains an array of Class 6 science quiz questions with options, answers, and unit metadata.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackgroundMusic.ts: Manages looping background audio with play, pause, volume, mute, and unlock controls.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, stored identity loading, and status tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styles, color variables, dark mode settings, and component utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/quiz/committedCounts.ts: Computes correct and wrong answer counts from committed quiz answers.
frontend/src/quiz/loadQuestions.ts: Loads questions by level, validates them, and reports detailed errors when files or data are invalid.
frontend/src/quiz/scoring.ts: Calculates a quiz score including correct count and percentage.
frontend/src/quiz/types.ts: Defines question, answer, quiz state, and result TypeScript interfaces.
frontend/src/quiz/validateQuestions.ts: Validates question data, normalizes answers, resolves correct answer indices, and returns structured errors.
frontend/src/screens/LoginRequiredScreen: Presents a login prompt using Internet Identity with status handling and styled UI elements.
frontend/src/screens/QuestionScreen.tsx: Displays a timed question interface with option selection, auto-submit on timeout, and navigation controls.
frontend/src/screens/ResultsScreen.tsx: Shows final quiz results with score calculation, performance messaging, and restart/review actions.
frontend/src/screens/ReviewScreen.tsx: Provides a scrollable review of all questions with correctness indicators and navigation back or restart options.
frontend/src/screens/StartScreen.tsx: Renders the quiz start interface with shuffle toggle, metadata display, and background music activation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, animations, and extended theme settings.
project_state.json: Stores the project's state, including metadata, existing features, and architectural rules. Contains no new feature requests and notes a requirement to publish the current build to a specified custom domain.
